features.label: Galileo false-color swath
features.description: The colored measurement strip isolates the area in which Europa's impact scar was studied.

explanation: The city-sized crater is difficult to read as a familiar bowl on an icy, reworked surface. The mapped swath provides context without pretending every colored patch is a separate feature.
colorMethod: The colors are assigned to Galileo measurements to expose compositional or surface differences; they are not Europa's appearance to the eye.
whyItMatters: This reading separates what the image shows directly from what instruments, processing and context allow us to infer.
